title: France vs. Japan - Women's football (London 2012 Olympics)
author: sachab
dims_or_duration: 4608x3456 original; local copy is the 1280x960 thumbnail
notes: Mid/wide shot at Wembley, 2012-08-06: ~14 players, white kits vs dark navy kits on striped grass. Original is 4,015,945 bytes (over 3 MB), so the local file is the Commons thumbnail https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/79/France_vs._Japan_-_Women%27s_football.jpg/1280px-France_vs._Japan_-_Women%27s_football.jpg (347,019 bytes); original also downloaded as photo_france_japan_2012_orig.jpg. Crowd in red seats fills the top ~20%: crop it or mask to grass before clustering.

title: Chants des supporters du RCS sur l'air de Vive le vent (RC Strasbourg supporters)
author: Xaviyeah
notes: Strasbourg supporters singing to the tune of Jingle Bells (recorded 2017). Crowd chant with clear rhythm, good for spectrogram/onset/tempo demos.

title: Dai Frosinone, vinci con la forza del Leone (Frosinone Calcio away fans)
author: Sardognunu
notes: Fan chant recorded in the away end during a Frosinone Calcio match (2005). Longer clip with stadium ambience between repetitions. Alternative if a longer in-crowd recording is wanted: File:WWS_FootballAustriavs.Sweden.ogg (CC BY 4.0, 227 s, 3.1 MB, not downloaded, over the 120 s target).

title: Latvia vs Gibraltar football match, Skonto Stadium, Riga, 2026-03-31
author: Mārtiņš Bruņenieks
notes: Handheld phone clip from the stands, one continuous take (ffmpeg scene>0.3 finds 0 cuts): opens on fans with flags and flare smoke, pans to the goal, then to live play (red vs white kits) in smoky floodlight. Good for frame differencing / motion energy and as a no-cut negative control; camera pans give large global motion, so subtract it or compare with the newsreel. Original is AV1 (needs an AV1-capable decoder such as recent ffmpeg/PyAV); a VP9 Commons transcode was also downloaded and works: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/transcoded/0/06/Latvia-Gibraltar_football_2026-03-31.webm/Latvia-Gibraltar_football_2026-03-31.webm.480p.vp9.webm (854x480, 1,764,013 bytes, local video_latvia_gibraltar_2026.480p.vp9.webm).
